shots.action: Storm over a jungle ridge: a small three-engine jet skims in low under the cloud, its wing tears through the treetops, leaves and branches burst, lightning
shots.camera: Wide and low from the slope, looking up at the ridge line

shots.action: Inside the broken cabin: her face, eyes snapping open, a toppled seat pressing on her, green light and rain through the torn roof; she pushes at it
shots.camera: Close, overhead, slowly pushing in

shots.action: The broken fuselage in the trees on the slope in rain, nose gone; she lowers herself out of the open end, holding her jaw
shots.camera: Wide from downhill, drifting up

shots.action: The torn-off wing lying downslope in the ferns, metal bent, yellow insulation hanging from its root; Rook drops onto it out of the rain and folds his wings
shots.camera: Low along the wing, pushing in

shots.action: Rook on the wing in the rain, the wreck behind him; his brim drops over his eyes: 'Hurt like that? No chance.'
shots.camera: Close on Rook, three-quarter, wreck in the background

shots.action: Inside the cabin, two hands on a seat's armrest, his still; hers closes round his and holds on
shots.camera: Close and low on the hands, soft warm light, slow push

shots.action: Rook beside the fuselage takes off his hat and holds it to his chest, head bowed, rain on his feathers
shots.camera: Medium, eye level, slow drift in

shots.action: Under the wreck's edge she lies propped on one elbow, turned to the man lying near her; she reaches out, he does not move; she lowers her hand
shots.camera: Medium from behind her shoulder, slow push

shots.action: She sits alone against a root by the fuselage in the rain, knees up, the jungle dark around her
shots.camera: Wide-ish, slow pull back to show how alone she is

shots.action: Sun breaks through the canopy: close on her face, squinting, wiping her dry lips with a fingertip
shots.camera: Close, eye level, easing in

shots.action: Her view down the slope: the broken wing, its torn root stuffed with pale insulation; Rook on the wing points at it
shots.camera: Over her shoulder, rack to the wing

shots.action: Rook at the wing root pulls out a tuft of insulation and squeezes it; it springs back; he looks over at her, brows up
shots.camera: Close on Rook and the tuft

shots.action: She drags herself on her elbows over roots and leaves toward the wing, legs trailing, face set
shots.camera: Low at ground level in front of her, backing away

shots.action: Close on her hand pulling tufts of insulation out of the torn wing root and rolling them into little balls
shots.camera: Macro close, slow push

shots.action: Rook on the wing taps his beak, then nods slowly at her: she worked it out first
shots.camera: Close, low angle, sky behind

shots.action: Rain sweeps over the ridge, the trees thrash, Rook hunches on the fuselage roof, she holds the balls of insulation up into the rain
shots.camera: Wide, high, slow push

shots.action: Close on her face as she lifts a soaked ball to her lips and takes one sip, water dripping
shots.camera: Close, eye level, still and steady

shots.action: High above: endless green ridges under drifting cloud; no sign of the wreck under the canopy
shots.camera: Very high and wide, slow drift

shots.action: Rook on the top of the tallest tree scans the ridges, wing over his eyes; nothing; his shoulders drop
shots.camera: Medium on Rook, the ridges behind

shots.action: Night: the wreck a dark shape in the trees, fireflies drifting, she lies small by the fuselage
shots.camera: Wide, slow push

shots.action: Close on her face at night: eyes closed, breathing slowly, the fear going out of it as fireflies drift over her
shots.camera: Close, still, lit softly

shots.action: Rook sits quietly beside her on a root, hat in his lap, keeping watch while she rests
shots.camera: Medium, low, slow drift

shots.action: Dawn mist in the trees: a man in a khaki uniform and cap pushes through the leaves and stops dead
shots.camera: Medium from beside the wreck, looking up the slope

shots.action: Close on the officer's face: eyes wide, he steps back, then points and shouts down the hill
shots.camera: Close, eye level, quick push in

shots.action: Rook lifts his brim with one finger, eyes wide, then lets out a breath
shots.camera: Close on Rook

shots.action: Rescuers carry her down the slope on canvas slung between two sticks, in the morning light; she turns her head to the sky
shots.camera: Medium, tracking alongside downhill

shots.action: Rook alone by the empty fuselage, puts his hat back on and looks at the wreck a long moment
shots.camera: Wide-ish, slow pull back

shots.action: The carry party goes down the jungle path into sunlight, small among the giant trees
shots.camera: Wide from uphill, slow crane

shots.action: Rook on the wing picks up a loose rivet, turns it in the light, pockets it and tips his hat
shots.camera: Medium, slow push

shots.action: The opening shot played back to its first frame, so the end runs into the start
shots.camera: As the first shot
